main_body: Wooden bin box with a heap of black coal rising above its front rim, set against the background tiles
top_band: Coal heap, near-black (L~19), rows 3-9 at x=8, then a light-brown front rim at row 10 (L=104)
evidence: In the x=8 column the coal surface runs rows 3-9, a step to the light rim line at row 10 (L=104), a dark eave row 11 (L=39), then the wood front face at rows 12-14. The coal heap counts as the visible inside of the opening under rule 11b, and the light side walls frame it. The front face is short and the coal is almost the same tone as the outline, so the top is weakly read. The front-edge line and eave shadow are both present, and the heap is clearly above the front rim, so it passes narrowly.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile, against 38-40 colours and 17-20 per tile in the references. The coal is a nearly uniform near-black mass with no highlights or lumps. The wood front has only about 3 tones and no grain or plank texture. Dark edge pixels are 29% neutral, so the outline is mixed with a black-ish line. This is clearly thinner and flatter than the Beodeul references.
